title: A Critical and Exegetical Commentary on the Book of Daniel (ICC)
license: Published 1927; public domain in the US; paraphrased

verification_log.method: Downloaded and read the OCR text, pp. 307–308, 317–318

Three classes of son-of-man interpretation: (1) personal, messianic — "the eldest" and formerly prevailing in Jewish and Christian exegesis; (2) symbolic of the people of the saints — "itself an ancient view"; (3) mythological — recent; messianic and non-messianic views found "almost indifferently with conservatives and radicals"; Montgomery holds that the saints are the group typified by the human figure
